build_transformer_seq_model: build a transformer model for sequential prediction with configurable attention span and multi-head attention
create_seq_attention_layer: create a sequential self-attention layer that attends to previous L positions using relative position embeddings
create_multi_head_attention: create a multi-head sequential attention module with query, key, value projections and head reshaping
build_transformer_layers: build stacked transformer sequential layers with attention and feedforward sublayers and layer normalization
run_transformer_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the transformer sequential model with input embeddings and hidden state cache
